basic_details.job_title: IPC SVIMS Pharmacovigilance Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) has notified 1 vacancy for the Pharmacovigilance Assistant post on a contract basis with a place of posting in Tirupati. Candidates can apply by email by downloading the application format from the website, filling it, attaching attested copies of supporting documents, and sending the scanned application in PDF format on or before 15 October 2026. The required qualification is a Master degree in Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, and Clinical Research OR Pharm.D/ MBBS/BDS from a recognised university/Institute with one year experience

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Master degree in Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, and Clinical Research OR Pharm.D/ MBBS/BDS from a recognised university/Institute with one year experience in drug safety/Pharmacovigilance after obtaining essential qualification. | Other Requirements: Candidates must have proficiency in computer. The age of the person should not exceed 28 years.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates shall go through the written test/interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IPC Pharmacovigilance Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for the Pharmacovigilance Assistant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated emolument is Rs. 32,000 per month, paid by the authorised manpower agency of IPC.

faq.question: Q3. Is the post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis initially for a period of one year or till further orders, whichever is earlier, and can be extended based on performance or department requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of the person should not exceed 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will go through a written test/interview.
